## Services & Offerings
- **Performance Ads & Attribution (4.2x Avg ROAS):** Setup Meta/Google/TikTok campaigns, server-side Conversion API (CAPI), GTM server container setup, GA4 audit, and custom dashboard reporting.
- **Organic Seeding & Advocacy (85% Trust Index):** Dialogue engineering, Reddit and forum outreach, community monitoring, and KOC booking to build organic product recommendation.
- **Brand Marketing & Positioning:** Market positioning audits, core value propositions, styleguides, and message mapping.
- **E-Commerce Growth (+28% Conversion):** Conversion rate optimization (CRO) on Shopify, Klaviyo email retention flows, catalog ad feed optimization.
- **Astro & React Web Engineering (100/100 Speed):** Blazing-fast static site builds on Astro and React, technical SEO schema structure, headless CMS setups.

## Key Projects & Case Studies

### 1. PlayAh! Revenue & TikTok Shop Scaling (2024-Present)
- **Role:** Performance Senior Executive
- **Outcomes:** Scaled website revenue 10x in 2 months. Grew Meta Ads 2x MoM with ROAS > 5. Built TikTok Shop from scratch to 30x+ GMV growth within 2 months (ROAS > 10, ranked #1 in category).

### 2. WorkFlow Space: Branch Launch Performance (2024-Present)
- **Role:** Digital Marketing Executive
- **Outcomes:** Managed VND 300M paid budget, generating 2,000+ leads and 4M+ impressions. Rebranded visual identity and built custom landing pages with 400+ leads/month at a 35-40% conversion rate.

### 3. POPS Worldwide: SEO & Organic Growth (2022-2023)
- **Role:** Search Engine Optimization Executive
- **Outcomes:** Scaled POPS Vietnam organic traffic to 2.5M monthly users (10x user growth). Launched POPS Kids Learn, acquiring 10,000+ active users in 4 months.

### 4. TOMATO Children's Home: Enrollment Growth (2023-2024)
- **Role:** Digital Marketing Executive
- **Outcomes:** Scaled monthly student enrollment by 3x and reduced cost-per-lead (CPL) by 60%. Managed 40,000+ contact email flows with > 60% open rates.

### 5. Education Communities (2021-Present)
- **Role:** Founding Member
- **Outcomes:** Co-founded and scaled "Dai Hoc Dung Hoc Dai" and "Di Lam Dung Di Lam" communities to 3M and 1M members respectively within 12 months.
